original_target.title: Recover an arbitrary sound speed from one incident direction

scope_comparison: Oksanen–Rakesh–Salo August theorem requires pseudoconvexity and the no-caustics EIC and complementary measurements. The scalar-speed specialization following Theorem2.8 removes the spanning condition but not those geometric hypotheses or complementary data. Si's September result has a frequency-independent zeroth-order Schrödinger potential V; the target acoustic contrast is multiplied by k² and cannot be substituted into its fixed-V all-frequency hypothesis.
